Terms of service

Last updated: 19 November 2026

These terms apply to every consignment booked with Sabri Logistics. The GC (goods consignment) receipt issued at booking is the contract between you and us.

Booking

  • The consignor must declare the correct description, quantity, weight and value of the goods, and provide the invoice and e-way bill where the law requires them.
  • We do not carry goods that are illegal, dangerous, or banned from transport by road.
  • Charges (freight, booking, door delivery, handling, other and GST) are shown on the GC receipt.

Payment

  • Paid: charges are paid by the consignor at booking.
  • To Pay: charges are paid by the consignee before the goods are handed over.
  • To be Billed: for approved regular customers, charges are billed periodically.

Delivery

  • Goods are delivered at the destination branch, or to the consignee's door when door delivery is booked.
  • The consignee should check the goods at delivery and note any damage or shortage on the delivery slip.
  • Goods not collected within a reasonable time may attract godown charges.

Liability

We take reasonable care of your goods. Our liability for loss or damage is limited as set out on the GC receipt and under the Carriage by Road Act, 2007. Insurance of the goods is the owner's responsibility unless agreed otherwise in writing.

Messages

If you share a WhatsApp number at booking, we send the GC receipt and booking updates to it, as described in our privacy policy.

Jurisdiction

All disputes are subject to the courts at Veraval, Gujarat.
